339	Seven sons who were Cohen Gadol is beyond nature, it can't be, it makes no sense at all.	Sete filhos Cohen Gadol está acima da natureza, não pode ser, não faz sentido nenhum.

341	She said to them, never did the beams of my house see the hair of my head.	Ela lhes disse: as vigas da minha casa nunca viram os cabelos da minha cabeça.
342	Understand what modesty she had even at home, within her own four cubits, which is piety beyond nature.	Entendam que tsniut ela tinha mesmo em casa, nos seus quatro côvados, o que é uma piedade acima da natureza.

346	Even so, she had such modesty inside the house; all the more so she was modest in the streets of the city.	Mesmo assim, ela tinha tamanha tsniut dentro de casa; quanto mais era recatada nas ruas da cidade.
347	She didn't wear clothes that were too tight, too rustling, too colorful, too see-through.	Não vestia roupas justas demais, barulhentas demais, coloridas demais, transparentes demais.
348	She wouldn't speak with men, she wouldn't enter places where there is no modesty.	Não conversava com homens, não entrava em lugares sem tsniut.
349	She guarded her modesty, and she merited seven sons who were Cohen Gadol.	Ela guardava a sua tsniut e mereceu sete filhos Cohen Gadol.
